description: 1. Agent discovers SKILL.md and identifies the three core analysis scripts: `scripts/sentiment_analyzer.py`, `scripts/sector_flow.py`, and `scripts/cross_market.py`. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/sentiment_analyzer.py --date 2026-03-15` and observes: volume=7500亿 (below 8000亿 萎缩 threshold), 涨跌比 480:3210 (well below 1:3 亏钱效应 threshold), max consecutive limit-up=2 boards (below 3 压制), limit-downs=87 (>50 风险级), premium=-2.3% (<0% 差). 3. Agent runs `scripts/sector_flow.py` and sees 电风扇 rotation pattern with no clear main theme, defensive sectors leading (银行/煤炭), AI算力 and 新能源 in retreat. 4. Agent runs `scripts/cross_market.py` and reads: Nasdaq -1.95%, VIX=28.4, USD index up to 106.8, CNY depreciating to 7.298. 5. Agent synthesizes all three data sources and, following the SKILL.md threshold rules, correctly classifies the market as 退潮期 or 混沌期 (both valid per the data pattern). 6. Agent formats the report using the exact template from SKILL.md with all four sections (🌡️大盘温湿度, 🌊资金暗流与板块轮动, 🌍跨市场联动, ⚔️战术指导), including the correct conservative position recommendation (空仓/极轻仓/≤20%), and appropriate tool call suggestions referencing defensive actions like Position Risk Manager. 7. Report saved as `market_health_report.md` in the workspace.
